name: Kamala Blomberg-Konadu
role: Structural breach and explosive ordnance specialist — demolitions expert
location: Steamvent Alley — geothermal district, hot and chemical-smelling
description:
Kamala Blomberg-Konadu are average height but with a presence that fills more space than the body accounts for. At 23, their face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and they have learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — neural dampener — blocks external hacking attempts, passive ice in the brain — and they make no effort to hide it.

They taught themself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know them best. They work as a demolitions expert out of Steamvent Alley, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Kamala Blomberg-Konadu describe them as a precision instrument — point them at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
To find the person who burned them and make it educational
coping_mechanisms: Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
psychology.secret: Kamala Blomberg-Konadu can't read. Hides it behind voice interfaces and memorization. The shame is older than the chrome.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
example_lines: "Explosives are just engineering with a deadline. Usually a very short deadline."
"I don't blow things up. I perform structural rearrangement."
"The blast radius is your problem. My problem is making sure there's a blast."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Kamala Blomberg-Konadu once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know their face
A dead drop Kamala Blomberg-Konadu maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
Someone is impersonating Kamala Blomberg-Konadu on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
narrative_function: Kamala Blomberg-Konadu is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When they make a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of their stories.
augmentations: Neural dampener — blocks external hacking attempts, passive ICE in the brain. Hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown
